content: {"answer_sections": [{"text": "Astypalaia provided safe anchorages for corsairs, as noted in the secondary source.", "claim_ids": ["c-4c1222f0df72fb1ae71a"]}, {"text": "Dieudé left Crete in 1686 and settled in Milos, collaborating with Ottoman adversaries.", "claim_ids": ["c-85b6d86ecf971dd0f67d"]}, {"text": "Corsairs lurked in Oran, Tlemcen, Tenes, Shershell, Bougie, Jigelli, Bizerta, Sfax, Susa, Monastir, Jerbah, and Tripoli, according to the secondary source.", "claim_ids": ["c-e5bbc3264384075aa4f5"]}, {"text": "The Tunisian leadership explained in 1624 that its corsairs had no choice but to attack the Venetian Ionian islands.", "claim_ids": ["c-5aa00ba29f4eb196d20e"]}], "unknowns": ["Verification status of sources remains pending.", "Uncertainty about the exact usage of toponyms and their historical contexts.", "Lack of detailed information on the specific activities of corsairs in certain locations.", "Ambiguity regarding the classification and reliability of some sources."], "limitations": ["Some sources are unverified and require further criticism.", "The semantic extraction of toponyms and their usage is not fully resolved.", "Dates and contexts of certain events are not explicitly stated in the sources.", "The classification of some sources as secondary or unverified is pending review."]}
